ai.purpose: RTT/1 engine layer for General Relativity: operator grammar, curvature behavior, geodesics, and minimal coherence examples.

engine.description: Defines the operator grammar and dimensional behavior of gravitational geometry within the RTT substrate.

curvature.description: Describes how mass-energy shapes spacetime geometry.

geodesic_motion.description: Determines the natural path of free-falling objects in curved spacetime.

metric_tensor.description: Encodes distances, intervals, and causal structure.

stress_energy.description: Represents mass-energy content that generates curvature.

equivalence_principle.description: Local inertial frames behave identically to special relativity.

connection_coefficients.description: Define how vectors change under parallel transport.

boundary_conditions.description: Determine behavior at horizons, infinities, and interfaces.

dimensional_mapping.R3: Full geometric coherence; stable curvature and geodesic structure.

integration.notes: RTT/1 treats GR as a geometric coherence theory; substrate-level causes are resolved in RTT/2 and RTT/3.
